open_points.subject: _sync_folder
open_points.text: _sync_folder: [BEHAVIOR] MUST open the folder read-only as a folder, call os.fsync on that descriptor and close it on every path, letting any OSError pass to its caller.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Describe the required durable synchronization and descriptor cleanup without the dotted os.fsync operation.

open_points.subject: project_lock
open_points.text: project_lock: [BEHAVIOR] MUST be a contextlib.contextmanager generator that makes the folder of the imported LOCKS_FOLDER constant exist below the state_dir of context with _make_folders, the imported STATE_FOLDER_MODE constant and durable false, then creates the lock file named by the canonical project id followed by the imported LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX constant exclusively, without following a link, with the imported LOCK_FILE_MODE constant, or, when it exists, opens it as it stands without following a link; it MUST take fcntl.flock with fcntl.LOCK_EX on that descriptor, waiting without a time limit and with no retry of its own, yield once while holding it, and release and close it on every exit. Neither the lock file nor its folder is synchronised, a lock found partly created is completed and nothing created is removed.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Describe the context-manager and exclusive-lock behavior without dotted contextlib or fcntl operation names.
